name: Quest: the walk timer clock runs live and pauses

planSteps.description: Open the app at / and wait up to 30 seconds for the '[ SYSTEM ]' window to appear (a Flutter web app; it can take a while to load, and controls are exposed in the accessibility tree)
On the '[ CHOOSE YOUR SYSTEM ]' window, click the 'FITNESS' tile
Click 'SUBMIT' on the '[ PLACEMENT TEST ]' window
Click 'CONTINUE' on the '[ YOUR DAILY QUEST ]' window
Click 'CONFIRM APPS' on the '[ LOCK TARGETS ]' window (the web build lists no apps; that is expected)
Click 'CONFIRM' on the '[ REST PERIOD ]' window
Click 'HOLD TO ACCEPT' once on the '[ PENALTY TERMS ]' window (this test build accepts a click in place of the hold)
The 'Walk' objective shows a clock reading '00:00:00' and a 'START' button
The Walk clock shows at least '00:00:04' (it advanced on its own) and the label 'RUNNING' is visible
The label under the Walk clock reads 'PAUSED' and the button reads 'RESUME'
